Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates severe scoliosis with a rightward convexity, which mechanically compresses the right hemithorax and reduces right lung volume. This compression predisposes the patient to atelectasis or infection (manifesting as right basal shadowing) and leads to deteriorated respiratory function, consistent with the clinical history of dyspnea and impaired pulmonary tests.
